Such a prophet or dreamer must be put to death, because he has advocated rebellion against the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt and redeemed you from the house of slavery; he has tried to turn you from the way in which the LORD your God has commanded you to walk. So you must purge the evil from among you.
The River Kishon swept them away, the ancient river, the River Kishon. March on, O my soul, in strength!

And on that day, declares the LORD of Hosts, I will erase the names of the idols from the land, and they will no longer be remembered. I will also remove the prophets and the spirit of impurity from the land.

verses.text: And Elijah said to Ahab, “Go up, eat and drink, for there is the sound of a heavy rain.”

xrefs.text: After a long time, in the third year of the drought, the word of the LORD came to Elijah: “Go and present yourself to Ahab, and I will send rain upon the face of the earth.”
Go, eat your bread with joy, and drink your wine with a cheerful heart, for God has already approved your works:

Now Elijah the Tishbite, who was among the settlers of Gilead, said to Ahab, “As surely as the LORD, the God of Israel, lives, before whom I stand, there will be neither dew nor rain in these years except at my word!”
So for your own preservation, I urge you to eat something, because not a single hair of your head will be lost.

verses.text: So Ahab went up to eat and drink. But Elijah climbed to the summit of Carmel, bent down on the ground, and put his face between his knees.

Then Jesus told them a parable about their need to pray at all times and not lose heart:
Then the man said, “Let me go, for it is daybreak.” But Jacob replied, “I will not let you go unless you bless me.”
You need to persevere, so that after you have done the will of God, you will receive what He has promised.

verses.text: On the seventh time the servant reported, “There is a cloud as small as a man’s hand rising from the sea.” And Elijah replied, “Go and tell Ahab, ‘Prepare your chariot and go down before the rain stops you.’”

So the men did as instructed. They took two milk cows, hitched them to the cart, and penned up their calves.

verses.text: Meanwhile, the sky grew dark with clouds and wind, and a heavy rain began to fall. So Ahab rode away and went to Jezreel.
